subtitle.zh: 地铁、冥河与重叠世界｜概念音乐影像
subtitle.en: Subway, Styx, and overlapping worlds | Conceptual music video

description.zh: 将伦敦地铁转化为当代冥界渡船，以实拍、数字特效与三维空间展开现实与冥河之间的旅程。
description.en: London’s subway becomes a contemporary ferry to the underworld, merging live-action, digital effects, and 3D spaces in a journey between reality and Styx.

kind.zh: 概念音乐影像 · 协作项目

coverAlt.zh: 地铁、扶梯、时钟与重叠圆形构成的 ALILAGUNA 完整概念拼贴。
coverAlt.en: An ALILAGUNA concept collage of subway structures, escalators, clocks, and overlapping circles.

role.zh: 影像导演：拍摄、剪辑、调色、VFX 与排版
role.en: Image director: filming, editing, colour grading, VFX, and layout

deliverables.zh: 完整 MV、概念拼贴、音乐分析、十二格分镜与制作过程
deliverables.en: Full music video, concept collages, music analysis, twelve-shot storyboard, and production studies

overview.zh: 一段从现实走向死亡边界、再返回现实的旅程。地铁成为当代渡船：失灵的指示牌与扭曲的时间，让稳定的日常逐渐松动。影像将实拍、数字特效与三维空间相结合，通过倒放、镜像与分屏，使现实与虚拟世界彼此渗透。
overview.en: A journey from reality to the edge of the afterlife, and back. The subway becomes a contemporary ferry: failing signage and distorted time unsettle everyday order. Live-action footage, digital effects, and 3D spaces merge through reversal, mirroring, and split screens, allowing real and virtual worlds to overlap.
